shots.action: A night bus window fills the frame, seen from inside the darkened vehicle, the camera locked off and never moving. Cold raindrops bead across the glass in irregular clusters, some clinging in place and trembling, others breaking loose and dragging short crooked trails through the condensation. Beyond the pane the city is a soft wash of out-of-focus light — amber streetlamps, a red smudge of a tail light, a pale green glow — all smeared and wavering as the water bends and scatters it. The dark interior reflects faintly on the inner surface, a dim ghost of the cabin overlapping the moving lights. Nothing inside the bus is disturbed; only the rain travels.
shots.what_changes: Droplets gather on the glass and the first few begin to slide, smearing the lights behind them.

subjects: a single large raindrop on the bus window glass
condensation and smaller beads on the pane
blurred city lights behind the glass
sync_sound: a faint low bus engine hum
a soft squeak of the drop dragging across the pane
shots.action: The shot cuts to a tighter, close-in view of the same locked-off bus window, the same night city still blurred to colored haze behind the glass. A single large droplet sits heavy at the center of the pane, quivering, then draws a smaller neighbour into itself and swells; released, it runs a wavering vertical line down the condensation, gathering other beads as it goes and leaving a clear, sharply defined channel that momentarily sharpens the smear of amber and red light behind it. The camera holds absolutely still, and only the water moves within the frame.
shots.what_changes: The large droplet merges with a neighbour and runs downward, cutting a clear channel through the condensation.

description.text: A rain-streaked bus window fills the frame at night, seen from inside the darkened vehicle. Cold droplets bead across the glass in irregular clusters, some clinging and trembling while others begin to drag short crooked trails through the condensation. Beyond the pane, the city is a soft wash of out-of-focus light: amber streetlamps, a red smudge of a tail light, and a pale green glow smear and waver as the water bends them. A faint reflection of the dark cabin overlays the moving lights on the inner surface. Nothing inside the bus is disturbed; only the rain travels, and the framed view remains fixed on the glass.
Rain beads and thin condensation coat the night bus window, softening the blurred city lights beyond.
Soft, irregular rain patters against the glass over the low, muffled hum of the moving bus.
Several droplets break loose and slide downward, opening short crooked trails through the condensation.
The rain continues to tick faintly on the pane while the engine hum holds steady.
The camera holds a static shot.

A tighter, close-in view holds on the same rain-streaked bus window, with the night city still reduced to a colored haze behind the glass. A single large droplet sits heavy at the center of the pane, quivering, then draws a smaller neighbor into itself and swells. When it releases, it runs a wavering vertical line down the condensation, gathering other beads as it goes and leaving a clear, sharply defined channel that momentarily sharpens the smear of amber and red light behind it. The water moves within the fixed frame while the surrounding cabin remains dark and still.
A large raindrop sits heavy at the center of the condensation, surrounded by smaller beads and blurred colored lights.
Rain ticks softly on the glass, the low bus engine hums, and the window carries a faint interior resonance.
The large droplet merges with a smaller neighbor, swells, then runs downward in a wavering line.
A soft squeak accompanies the drop dragging across the pane as the rain continues to tick.
The camera holds a static shot.
